scheme_name: Small Business in Service/Trading Sector for Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan Swavalamban Yojana)
other_conditions: Disability of at least 40% is required
For persons with mental retardation, the eligible age is above 14 years
Must have Unique Disability ID (UDID) registration for loan amounts of ₹15 lakhs and above
Applicant must have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID)
benefits_summary: Loans up to ₹50 lakh are offered to persons with disabilities for self‑employment in various sectors.
documents_required: Age certificate issued by a competent authority authorized by the State Government
Unique Disability ID (UDID) registration proof (required for loans ≥ ₹15 lakh)
